reviews.x: It is flimsy and fell apart the first time I used it. The rest of my trip I had to hold it together and simultaneously brush it through my hair. A dab of superglue in the joints that connect the brush part to the swivel piece might keep it from falling apart every time you use it but as I was on a week long backpacking trip on the AT I did not have any super glue at the time. Will not be buying again.
I like the concept and it folds nicely as described.  But I have problems with it coming apart if I pull hard when untangling my hair. Sure it's easy to put back together but it is annoying.

reviews.t: I'm glad I picked a gift from my wife
reviews.x: Before, must comb and mirror to bring in a row when my wife, make her feel a bit inconvenient. Now with it, with one thing you have two object functions, reducing the burden of her travel. It has a moderate size and won't take up much of your place. So, it fits perfectly into your bag. It's definitely one of the necessities of the trip. I'm glad I picked a gift from my wife.

reviews.t: Id have to super glue this
reviews.x: It fell apart immediately. The mirror flap connected to the brush end, just unhooked. Id have to super glue this, to get it to stick. This is probably only good for sleek hair. I have thick wavy hair.

reviews.t: It's fine for the price but don't expect repeat uses
reviews.x: I got it for a month long trip taking only carry-on. It did what I needed but broke towards the end. It's fine for the price but don't expect repeat uses.

reviews.t: top part disconnects from mirror part
reviews.x: i have to constantly fix it because the brush part disconnects from the mirrored part - a little bit of super glue will fix it though
Super convenient for travels. Fits in your pocket or purse too.
It broke in half when I barely started to comb my hair.

This is my travel hair brush for short men’s hair. I’ve used brushes like this for years and prefer this style when traveling because it folds into itself. I can tell from experience this one will not hold up as well as others I’ve had. The mirror was wiggly loose on delivery. On day 1 using the brush, the mirror dropped out and shattered on the hotel bathroom floor. On day 3 using the brush, the handle separated from the bristles. I was able to reassemble, but it’s not going to hold together. I

reviews.t: Useful but I haven't used it much
reviews.x: I've had this for a while and have hardly ever used it...  hence why I haven't left a review until now.  I thought I would use it more especially after eating at a nice restaurant to make sure I didn't have food in my beard.  I would use it, but just haven't.  The brush is well made and I really like how it folds nicely into my pocket.  It's even small enough to keep in my waste coat pocket.  The mirror is a good size.  It's a good product, it's just I haven't used it much so take my review for

I just used this item for the first time and was very disappointed to find that brush broke apart on first use. The brush part detached very easily from the mirror part. Technically not broken but doesn't stay as one piece with use. I have never had a portable brush come apart so easily. Usually when I buy a portable brush they have lasted for years, not this one.

reviews.t: Very compact and convenient to carry in pocket
reviews.x: Not bad. Convenient and compact brush for my pocket. Very stiff to open, but no problem, I deliberately broke the mirror off for a smaller brush since I already have a mirror in my car visor and a mirror app in my phone. Unike a similarly designed brush I ordered last year from another vender, this brush did NOT have an overpowering chemical stench.

I bought this brush for vacation and within two uses the brush section fell off the mirror section. The two pegs were obviously not glued in properly. I tried to super glue it back together but it just keeps coming apart. Check target, cvs or even the dollar store and save some money.

I know this is a cheap travel brush, but it broke IMMEDIATELY. hard to open close, and the brush component separated from the handle. Super annoying. I was trying to find a replacement for the last one that I'd had for about 10 years, but no luck.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for, I guess
reviews.x: Ok, I just wanted a little hairbrush in my computer bag for when I travel, so I looked for an inexpensive option.  I didn't expect anything fancy but this thing is junk.  Falls apart every time I try to use it.  Live and learn, I suppose.

The mirror folds into itself and also along the hinge making brushing hard. Any kind of knots makes it fold into itself. Always have to keep a finger on the back to stop it from turning. The size is convenient.

I do not like this product. I have very thin hair but the brush broke within one day of using it. The brush part completely split from the mirror side. It does not clip back together. Do not waste your money.

reviews.t: Open it gently it's not a pocket knife
reviews.x: I've read some negative reviews on this item but I don't have a problem with it. Does what I want it to and fits in my pocket without being a bother to me. Yeah it's cheaply made but what isn't these days.
Not bad but if you have long hair or need a travel brush that will get through all your tangles this isn’t it. Snapped in half pretty quick for me and I was gentle!
This is poorly made. It fell apart almost instantly and it smelled terrible. Go with the one by Ancable instead. Have had that since August, and it’s been great.

reviews.t: Fragile; splits into two pieces upon first use
reviews.x: This became unhinged upon first use, and was not easy to put back together.  And would not stay together, so I had to get a refund.
Nice product, and it's exactly what I wanted.  However it's really stiff to open, but hopefully that will loosen more over time.
Mirror fell out when i opened it for the first time and then when i went to use it, it broke in half and the brissels fell out.
Flimsy.. wont stay open when brushing your hair. Top piece doesn't stay inserted into bottom piece. Worthless to use really.
It's the perfect size for traveling and the mirror is better than i expected.  It's not as stable as i had expected.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the brush detaches or falls apart from the mirror/handle, often on first use or shortly after.
Several reviewers suggest super glue as a fix for the joints coming apart.
Reviewers praise its compact, portable design that fits easily in a pocket, purse, or bag for travel.
Some reviewers find it hard or stiff to open and close.
A few reviewers note it is fine for the low price but not durable for repeat uses.
